name: Februum
source:
The Magician of February / The Corruption Magician

The other February Magician originally named Februum who can communicate and quell corrupted spirits simply by conversing and sympathizing with them. Misunderstood by humans hundreds of years ago to be an ally of the dangerous corrupted spirits, he was repeatedly tortured and killed. Eventually losing his mind from this, he was determined to have his revenge on those who wronged him until Airy stopped him.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12680449.vendetta]official bio[/url]]
